title: docs(pm-dispatch): carry tier and effort on the zone path by construction
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHEeQWcrM65WNZnsi1Bo8Tn7)_

Rule-change: yes

No card: the dispatch order is the card. This is the skill-text half of a two-PR change; the mechanical half (claim-write refusals and a dispatch hook) is a separate PR on branch `claude/project-thread-8xhy68` and touches no file this one does.

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感;车队内部:分区线程的开场消息固定带一句定档要求,认领时改卡的大小要写理由,开发代理收到没写档位和投入力度的派发令会先停下报告。
- 这是「定档防漏」这组改进里的文字一半:让分区派发自带定档要求,不再靠席位记得。
- 出错时最坏是区线程或开发代理多停一次、退回席位补一行;只改说明文字,合并后可直接撤回。
- 请确认这三处文字可以合并(本改动改了车队规则,需要你亲手合并)。

## What changes

Three files, 17 lines added and 21 removed, every file at or under its byte ceiling.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`**

- 开席 step 2 gains one sub-bullet: the opening message of every zone thread and L1 thread carries one fixed line verbatim. The line points at `execution-duties.md` 〈定档〉 and names the two duties that were missed: the claim's Container & model line states tier and effort, and every `os-dev` call passes `model` and `effort` explicitly and pastes that line. It restates no value; 〈定档〉 stays the one home of values.
- 区内规则, the claim bullet: the pointer to 〈定档〉 now sits here. It is removed from the 「省耗」 line, where it read as a saving tip.
- 区内规则, the per-round bullet: the seat reads each zone claim's Container & model line every round.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`**

- Changing the triage size at claim is no longer free: the claim's Container & model line carries `size-override:` followed by the reason. The grade still never changes at claim.

**`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`**

- The rule that sent an order without tier and effort back to the seat covered card threads and zones only. It now covers every dispatch, subagents included: an order with no `Container & model:` line stating tier and effort means `blocked` before any edit. For a thread or a zone, a line that lacks the derivation still counts as missing, as before.

### What paid for the new text

The byte ratchet has no headroom on these files and this PR raises no ceiling, so each addition is paid by a deletion in the same file.

| File | Before | After | Ceiling | Added | Removed |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `area-lease.md` | 6584 | 6583 | 6586 | 217 | 218 |
| `triage-duties.md` | 13544 | 13544 | 13544 | 51 | 51 |
| `os-dev.md` | 38986 | 38980 | 38986 | 72 | 78 |

Removed text, and where the rule still lives when the removed text was a rule:

- `area-lease.md`, 100 bytes: the line saying an L1 thread starts an isolated L2 subagent in parallel for a p1 card-thread card. It was a shorter copy of `contract-review.md` line 19, the file it cited, and `dispatch-runbook.md` line 129 says the same.
- `area-lease.md`, 43 bytes: the tier pointer in the 「省耗」 line, moved to the claim bullet.
- `area-lease.md`, 26 bytes: a quoted maintainer phrase kept as provenance beside the rule "a backlog splits a zone again". The rule is unchanged.
- `area-lease.md`, 24 bytes: the clause "the two are not one word" after the sentence that already defines a zone and an `area:*` label separately.
- `area-lease.md`, 13 bytes: step 2 said "per the L1 thread rows of the section above"; it now says "per the section above".
- `area-lease.md`, 12 bytes: four wrapped list continuations joined onto their bullets. No word changes.
- `triage-duties.md`, 51 bytes: the tail of the `Fold-with:` line that pointed at the five fold gates in `execution-duties.md`. That file's own line on `Fold-with:` names the key and states when the proposal is valid; the triage line still says the audit comment may carry the proposal.
- `os-dev.md`, 78 bytes: alignment spaces in the footer illustration at the end of the file. The three footer lines and their notes are unchanged.

No ablation: the diff changes prose only, and no test pins it.

## Acceptance notes

- The fixed line lives in `area-lease.md` 开席 step 2, beside the authorization line step 3 already carries verbatim. The order proposed a full brief template in `project-forms.md`. That file has zero byte headroom, a full template costs several hundred bytes, and a ceiling raise needs a ruling comment id and an edit under `scripts/`, which the order placed out of scope. The fixed line is the part of a template that has to be the same every time; the seat still writes the identity and lease lines of the brief.
- `SKILL.md` and `execution-duties.md` are untouched. The claim template line does not show the `size-override:` spelling; the triage rule names it and its place.
- This text names no tool from the mechanical PR, so neither PR depends on the other's wording. The `size-override:` spelling here is the one the order gave; if the mechanical PR parses a different spelling, one of the two changes.
- A dev now stops on any subagent order that lacks the Container & model line. Seats that dispatch from an older copy of the skill will see `blocked` reports until their orders carry the line.
- The ratchet rows for `area-lease.md` and `os-dev.md` now have 3 and 6 bytes of headroom. Lowering those rows is an edit under `scripts/` and is not part of this PR.
- The branch carries one merge of `main` taken before the PR was opened; `main` had not touched these three files.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, the one changed rule line in 何时停手不写码. It widens a stop condition from threads and zones to every dispatch.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, the removed p1 line under 分不分区 and the new sub-bullet under 开席 step 2. Check the removed line against `contract-review.md` line 19.
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`, the size sentence and the shortened `Fold-with:` line.

Two-minute check: run `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`. It exits 0 and prints the three rows quoted under Tests.
